title: A Codex re-sign-in wipes the existing account's config.toml before the login
what: sign_in writes HOME_CONFIG over the account home's config.toml before running the login, even when the home belongs to an existing account. A cancelled, failed or merely repeated re-authentication therefore replaces the home's settings and its Codex project trust entries with the single sign-in line, contradicting the comment below it and the C25 test that promise an existing home keeps its settings, project trust and sessions.
expected: For an existing home, config.toml keeps its settings and project trust: the sign-in line is merged in (or the file is only created when missing), and a cancelled or failed re-authentication leaves the file exactly as it was.
